title: Baklava Walnut Honey Layers

seo.title: Walnut Baklava Recipe: Flaky Honey Layers
seo.metaDescription: Learn to make authentic Walnut Baklava with flaky layers, sweet honey syrup, and rich walnuts. This easy Middle Eastern dessert recipe is perfect for any occasion!

seo.imageAlt: Close-up of golden, flaky walnut baklava drizzled with honey syrup, garnished with chopped pistachios.
seo.imageCaption: Indulge in the irresistible sweetness of homemade Walnut Baklava, a classic Middle Eastern dessert with crispy layers and rich honey.

description: Experience the classic delight of Baklava Walnut Honey Layers, a cherished Middle Eastern dessert. Each bite offers a symphony of crispy, buttery phyllo pastry, generously filled with finely chopped walnuts, all drenched in a fragrant, golden honey syrup. This exquisite treat is perfect for celebrations or a sweet indulgence.

instructions.title: Prepare the Honey Syrup
instructions.text: Combine water, sugar, and honey in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the lemon juice, then remove from heat and let the syrup cool completely. It is crucial for the syrup to be cool when poured over hot baklava.

instructions.title: Prepare the Walnut Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the finely chopped walnuts, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, and ground cinnamon. Mix well to ensure the ingredients are evenly distributed. This mixture will provide the delicious nutty flavor to your baklava.

instructions.title: Preheat Oven and Prepare Pan
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 325F (160C). Brush a 9x13 inch baking pan generously with some of the melted butter. Lay out your phyllo dough and keep it covered with a damp cloth to prevent it from drying out while you work.

instructions.title: Layer the Phyllo Dough
instructions.text: Place about 8-10 sheets of phyllo dough in the bottom of the prepared pan, brushing each sheet lightly with melted butter before adding the next. Spread half of the walnut mixture evenly over the phyllo layers. Repeat with another 8-10 sheets of buttered phyllo, then spread the remaining walnut mixture. Top with the remaining phyllo sheets, again brushing each sheet with butter.

instructions.title: Cut and Bake the Baklava
instructions.text: Using a sharp knife, carefully cut the baklava into diamond or square shapes, cutting all the way through the layers but not disturbing the bottom. Pour any remaining melted butter evenly over the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

instructions.title: Pour Syrup and Cool
instructions.text: Immediately after removing the hot baklava from the oven, slowly and evenly pour the cooled honey syrup over the entire surface. The hot baklava will absorb the cool syrup, creating a moist and flavorful dessert. Let the baklava cool completely at room temperature for several hours, or preferably overnight, before serving.

tips: Always keep phyllo dough covered with a damp cloth to prevent it from drying out and cracking while you are working with it.
For an extra rich flavor, clarify your butter before melting. This removes milk solids and results in a purer fat that crisps the phyllo beautifully.
Allow the baklava to cool completely and absorb the syrup overnight for the best texture and flavor. Rushing this step will result in a less satisfying dessert.
